title: deposit_effects_exact
description: A successful deposit(assets, receiver) takes exactly assets DAI from the caller, mints shares = floor(assets * RAY / chi) to receiver (chi being the Pot accumulator after drip), increases totalSupply and sDAI's Pot pie by shares, changes no other share balance, and returns shares.

title: mint_effects_exact
description: A successful mint(shares, receiver) mints exactly shares to receiver, takes assets = ceil(shares * chi / RAY) DAI from the caller, increases totalSupply and sDAI's Pot pie by shares, changes no other share balance, and returns assets.

title: withdraw_effects_exact
description: A successful withdraw(assets, receiver, owner) delivers exactly assets DAI to receiver, burns shares = ceil(assets * RAY / chi) from owner, decreases totalSupply and sDAI's Pot pie by shares, changes no other share balance, and returns shares.

title: redeem_effects_exact
description: A successful redeem(shares, receiver, owner) burns exactly shares from owner, delivers assets = floor(shares * chi / RAY) DAI to receiver, decreases totalSupply and sDAI's Pot pie by shares, changes no other share balance, and returns assets.

title: rounding_favors_vault
description: No sDAI method decreases the internal Vat dai held by the sDAI contract: across deposit, mint, withdraw and redeem the vault always receives at least the value it pays out (shares * chi <= assets * RAY on entry, shares * chi >= assets * RAY on exit).

title: round_trip_no_profit
description: Within one block, depositing assets and immediately redeeming the minted shares returns at most assets; minting shares and immediately withdrawing the DAI paid burns at least those shares. No sequence of entry and exit at the same rate yields more DAI than was put in.

title: preview_matches_action
description: In the same block and state, previewDeposit, previewMint, previewWithdraw and previewRedeem return exactly what deposit, mint, withdraw and redeem return, even when the Pot has not been dripped (the views price at the accrued rate).

title: actions_price_at_accrued_rate
description: A depositor cannot buy shares at a stale (undripped) rate and capture interest that accrued before their deposit: after deposit, mint, withdraw or redeem, the Pot has been dripped to the current block (rho == block.timestamp) and the amount was computed with that post-drip chi.

title: third_party_value_unaffected
description: Within one block, no sDAI call by one actor changes the DAI value (convertToAssets of balance) of another actor who is not the owner, receiver or caller of that call: going first or last gains nothing at others' expense.

title: share_price_independent_of_donations
description: Sending DAI or internal Vat dai directly to the sDAI contract does not change convertToShares or convertToAssets, so the first depositor / donation inflation attack has no effect.

title: share_price_never_decreases
description: With a savings rate dsr >= RAY, no sDAI operation decreases the Pot accumulator chi, so the DAI value of a share never goes down.

title: deposit_pulls_only_from_caller
description: For every sDAI method, the DAI balance of any account other than the caller does not decrease (an approval to sDAI cannot be used by someone else to deposit the approver's DAI).

title: redeem_always_possible
description: A holder with balance b can always redeem(b', receiver, self) for any b' <= b to a valid receiver (not zero, not the DAI token) when the Maker system is sound (pot covers savings, rate accumulation does not overflow), including after Pot cage.

title: max_functions_accurate
description: maxRedeem(owner) == balanceOf(owner) and redeeming it succeeds; withdraw(maxWithdraw(owner)) succeeds and burns no more than the owner's balance; maxDeposit/maxMint do not exceed the amount deposit/mint accept for a caller with unlimited DAI (ERC-4626).
